name: smwgraphics-sonic-cd-tidal-tempest-past
title: Sonic CD - Tidal Tempest (Past)
description:
A ruins like background from the past version of Tidal Tempest From Sonic CD.

Update: Ripped the BG with Lunar Magic Bitmap pasting feature.
Since tile 12A was empty like tile F8, I changed that tile to tile F8 and moved the last tile to tile 12A, saving 1 tile.
The former archive didn't even have a sample level for the underwater area and its palette. Mine has.
The former BG used the first colors of palette 4 and was badly organized. My version moves palette 4 to the 2nd half and it can be quite easily edited.
Moved the palette files in the 'Palettes' folder.
Added BG slot and palette number.

No credit required.
